Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 107. Category: feat. Altered dnd 5e feats.

You awaken the ability to mentally connect with others,
granting you the following benefits:
Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma
score by 1, to a maximum of your current Ability
Score Maximum.
You can speak telepathically to any creature you can
see within 60 feet of you. Your telepathic utterances
are in a language you know, and the creature
understands you only if it knows that language. Your
communication doesn’t give the creature the ability
to respond to you telepathically.
You can cast the Detect Thoughts spell, requiring no
stamina or components, and you must finish a long
rest before you can cast it this way again. Your
spellcasting ability for the spell is the ability
increased by this feat. If you have spell slots of 2nd
level or higher, you can cast this spell with them.
